title: Pontotoc city schools set Dec. 1 deadline for items for December board meeting
excerpt: The public meeting is scheduled for Dec. 10 at 12:30 p.m. The district has separate forms for field trips, donations, fundraisers and certain purchases.
locality: Pontotoc City School District, Pontotoc, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc City School District lists Tuesday, Dec. 1, as the deadline for items for its December school board meeting. The board meets Thursday, Dec. 10, from 12:30 to 1:30 p.m., according to the district calendar.

The district provides four separate request forms. They cover field trips, acceptance of donations, fundraisers and purchases from $5,000 to $75,000. A school submitting a fundraiser and a school seeking approval for a field trip can go to the same board forms page and choose the form for their request.

School board meetings are open to the public. The district lists 172 N. College St. as the board’s usual meeting place and links to its meeting calendar and agendas from the board website. For a question about a request or to confirm the December meeting location before traveling, the city district’s central office lists 662-489-3336.
